chunks: The people of the Book were not divided among themselves till after the clear proof had come to them.

key_terms.الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ: The People of the Book (Jews and Christians)

ai.seo_question: Why did the People of the Book divide into sects according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse highlights that the fragmentation of the People of the Book was not inherent but a consequence of rejecting the 'clear proof' (Al-Bayyinah), identified as the Prophet Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt. This rejection underscores the pivotal role of divine guidance in maintaining unity, linking the historical schism to the theological concept of Imamate as the enduring source of truth.
